summary: Batch F: wired Fukuzo and Yoritomo Sakuma (personality-wave-33) and Unfortunate Hesitation (strategy-wave-22). Built two independent copy primitives (copy one keyword / copy one ability) with a GrantedAbility model (permanent grants survive death, tested), the opposing player's general Either/Or decision (public view, decider-only quotes, auto-resolve, action and reaction-window origins), a payment-time alternate Gold source (Sakuma's first ability, whole card), a minimal whole-action negation (isolated for the merge with the Jinn-Kuen negation), a per-player forced pass, the Political action tag on the 14 wired Political abilities, and copy/either-or showcase scenarios for the two Alfredo UI issues. Shared lane: engine plus the view/wire contract (CardView.GrantedAbilities/GoldProduced, MatchView.PendingCopy/PendingEitherOr) and one client line (Main.Production reads the engine's GoldProduced). Published count pinned at 417 (414 on origin/main 8b378a8d plus these three).
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: python content 43 and collaboration 130 tests, core 216, published 57, gold-parity 18, gold-quote 20, battle-timing 23, recon-action 11, discipline-absent 15, deck-format 9, deck-workshop 10, deck-search 22, deck-look 15, daigotsu-bofana 19, card-copy 15, either-or 17, AI 24, server 8, transport 7, all green; the client project builds (dotnet build src/L5R.Client, 0 warnings); Godot import/smoke NOT run (no Godot editor in this worktree). 24 mutation checks: each key rule broken, a named test fails (one equivalent mutant), table in docs/decisions/2026-09-19-copy-and-either-or-primitives.md. No native or graphical playtest.
remaining: Human rules acceptance of the open questions in the decision doc (negation and non-Gold costs, copy persistence, auto-resolved choices, forced-pass scope). Merge origin/main when the sibling batch PRs land (the Jinn-Kuen negation, R) and pick which negation each card calls. UI: two issues for Alfredo (copy wizard, Either/Or wizard).
